label: ESG Integration in Delivery
description: Embed ESG into consulting delivery: engagement-level materiality, ESG-by-design recommendations, measurable advice impact, and greenwashing-safe client deliverables — anchored to CSRD/ESRS, ISSB IFRS S1/S2, and SFDR.

claudeKnowledge.description: CSRD (EU) 2022/2464 + ESRS, ISSB IFRS S1/S2, SFDR (EU) 2019/2088, EU Taxonomy Regulation (EU) 2020/852, NGFS climate scenarios, GRI Standards, IAS 36/37, plus the client's engagement materials and any sector frameworks supplied via local folders.

guidedInputs.label: Engagement Type
guidedInputs.description: What kind of consulting engagement are we embedding ESG into?

guidedInputs.label: Client Sector & Reporting Regime
guidedInputs.description: Which disclosure regime is the client subject to? This drives the materiality lens and the greenwashing-risk surface.

options.label: EU large/listed — CSRD + ESRS in scope
Private / SME in a CSRD client's value chain (VSME)
Voluntary reporter — no mandatory regime yet

guidedInputs.label: Priority ESG Dimensions
guidedInputs.description: Which ESG topics should the integration prioritise for this engagement?

options.label: Climate change — mitigation, adaptation, transition plan (ESRS E1 / IFRS S2)
Pollution, water, biodiversity & circular economy (ESRS E2–E5)

guidedInputs.label: Where Are We in Delivery?
guidedInputs.description: Determines whether to run engagement-level materiality, ESG-by-design review of recommendations, or a greenwashing screen of a near-final deliverable.

guidedInputs.label: Known Issues, Claims, or Concerns
guidedInputs.description: Describe the recommendation set, any green/net-zero claims already drafted, client sensitivities, or impact expectations the sponsor has voiced.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Deck already claims the new product line is 'carbon-neutral' and 'fully sustainable'; sponsor wants a headline ESG number for the board; no baseline emissions data exists yet; client has a 2030 net-zero pledge but no transition plan...

exampleInput: We are mid-delivery on a growth-strategy engagement for a Nordic industrial manufacturer (~3,000 FTE, listed, CSRD-in-scope from FY2025). The recommendation is to expand a coatings product line and enter two new export markets. The client's sponsor wants a one-line ESG message for the board, and the draft deck already labels the new line 'sustainable' and 'climate-friendly'. There is no double-materiality assessment for this product decision, no Scope 3 baseline, and the client has a 2030 net-zero pledge with no published transition plan. Embed ESG-by-design into our recommendations, define how we will measure the impact of our advice, and screen the deck for greenwashing before it goes to the board.

exampleValues.known_concerns: Deck labels the new coatings line 'sustainable' and 'climate-friendly' with no evidence. No double-materiality assessment for the product decision. No Scope 3 baseline. 2030 net-zero pledge exists but no ESRS E1 transition plan. Sponsor wants a single headline ESG number for the board.
